address: Shop 15, B1, 70 Xining South Road, Wanhua District, Taipei, 108, Taiwan
bio: This household name on the beef noodle scene has been building up a loyal following since 1949. The broth is slow cooked with beef bones and a blend of 10 Chinese herbs. Its exceptional flavour and depth perfectly complement the delicious ribbon noodles, which are hand-pulled to order. The tender local and Aussie beef is of course a highlight. Cold sides such as pork ear in aspic and pickled cabbage are made fresh daily.
